rationale.rules-based-checks: Deterministic linters, AST checks, regex, and unit tests verify generated code.
rationale.quality-debt: Experiments reveal functional regressions and failures in documentation, style, and maintainability.
rationale.counterpoint: Challenges pass@k's prevailing functional-correctness-only evaluation paradigm.
rationale.metrics: Defines instruction-following and regression metrics measuring quality.
rationale.framework: SWE-IF provides an extensible, reusable code-evaluation pipeline design.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented verifiers, augmented benchmarks, code, data, and testbed.
rationale.agentic: Models deliver complete implementations for artifact-level evaluation across both protocols.
rationale.steering: Benchmark substantively injects explicit constraints into generation prompts.
rationale.risk-quality: Empirically measures functional and non-functional quality failures in generated code.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled tasks compare 31 third-party models across manipulated instruction conditions.
